lines: {target}? Green stalks can hide quick trouble. I would trust solid blocks more than brave words.
If anyone heads for Bamboo Jungle, tell them: Keep a path cut behind you. I will be at the stonecutter.
Bamboo crowds the eye and the feet. I will remember that when I check the walls.
Bamboo Jungle is no small story. Stone remembers every bad step.
I will remember Bamboo Jungle as a green wall that rustles like whispers. I will keep spare blocks close.
